metadata.title: Sub-Riemannian geodesics in the affine-additive group
metadata.abstract: We derive the sub-Riemannian geodesics of the affine-additive group using the Pontryagin Maximum Principle (PMP) and compute the associated cut times. We then proceed to construct the Carnot-Carathéodory sphere of the affine-additive group as well as the flask surface; the latter is the analogue of the Pansu sphere (bubble set) in the first Heisenberg group.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: affine-additive 群的次黎曼测地线
analysis.workSummary: 用 Pontryagin 最大值原理求 affine-additive 群的次黎曼测地线及 cut time，构造 Carnot–Carathéodory 球面和作为 Pansu sphere 类比的 flask surface。
analysis.breakthrough: 为特定非交换群给出显式最短路径和球面几何。
analysis.limitations: flask surface 是类比构造；摘要没有据此宣称其解决相应等周问题。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者声明 LLM 仅用于图 4.1 和 4.2：ChatGPT-5.6 Sol 辅助编写交由 Mathematica 执行的制图代码。
